title: Pure Lightsworn
summary: Lightsworn cards only, with generic staples. The deck utilizes self-milling to fill the Graveyard with diverse Lightsworn names, unlocking rapid Synchro climbing into Minerva, the Athenian Lightsworn and devastating field wipes with Judgment Dragon.

summary.title: Starters & Milling Engines
points: Charge of the Light Brigade: Mills three cards from the top of the Deck as cost and adds any Level 4 or lower Lightsworn monster to your hand.
Solar Recharge: Discards a Lightsworn monster to draw two cards and mill two cards, accelerating through the deck while setting up GY names.
Raiden, Hand of the Lightsworn: Level 4 Tuner that mills two cards during the Main Phase and two more in the End Phase.
Lightsworn Dragonling: 2024 starter that Special Summons itself if you have a Lightsworn in the GY, mills a Lightsworn on summon, and adds Judgment Dragon if sent to the GY.
Weiss, Lightsworn Archfiend: 2024 Tuner that places a Lightsworn on top of the Deck to Special Summon itself and mill two, or revives a Lightsworn when milled.

summary.title: Opening: Dragonling and Synchro Ladder
steps: Activate Charge of the Light Brigade, milling three cards to search Lightsworn Dragonling.
Normal Summon Dragonling and activate its effect to send Weiss, Lightsworn Archfiend from Deck to GY, triggering Weiss to revive another Lightsworn from your GY.
Tune Level 4 Lightsworn Dragonling with Level 4 Weiss, Lightsworn Archfiend to Synchro Summon Level 8 Minerva, the Athenian Lightsworn.
Activate Minerva, the Athenian Lightsworn to mill Lightsworn monsters of different Types from the Deck to the GY up to the number of Lightsworn materials used, stocking your GY with names.
Trigger Dragonling in the GY to add Judgment Dragon from Deck to hand.

summary.title: Bosses & Field Wipes
points: Judgment Dragon: Iconic 3000 ATK boss that Special Summons itself from hand whenever you have four or more Lightsworn monsters with different names in the GY, paying 1000 LP to destroy every other card on the field.
Minerva, the Athenian Lightsworn: Level 8 Synchro that mills Lightsworn monsters on summon and prevents your Lightsworn cards from being banished by card effects.
Michael, the Arch-Lightsworn: Level 7 Synchro summoned with Lumina and Raiden that pays 1000 LP to banish any card on the field.
Judgment, the Dragon of Heaven: Level 8 Synchro that pays half your LP to destroy all other cards on the field if you have four or more Tuners with different names in your GY.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Lightsworn Aegis: Trap that negates opponent face-up cards up to the number of Lightsworn monsters you control, and Sets itself directly from the GY when milled by a Lightsworn card.
Lightsworn Judgment: Places itself on top of the Deck when milled by a Lightsworn effect, searching Judgment Dragon on its next trigger.
Lightsworn Sanctuary: Continuous Spell that collects Shine Counters when cards are sent to the GY to protect Lightsworn cards from destruction or recycle monsters.

summary.title: Excluded
points: Curious, the Lightsworn Dominion: Omitted due to its Forbidden status in the TCG format.
